tests.name: Root Directory is Single Origin Anchor
tests.description: Verifies that the root directory '/' is present and correctly has parent null with no parent directories above it.
tests.failure_message: The Root directory '/' must exist as the top-level origin of the inverted tree with parent set to null.

tests.name: User Account & Project Hierarchy Structure
tests.description: Verifies that /home/alex has parent '/home' and projects folder has parent '/home/alex'.
tests.failure_message: User and project hierarchy is incorrect. Ensure /home/alex points to /home, and cloud-app is nested inside /home/alex/projects.

tests.name: System Configuration & Server Log Absolute Addresses
tests.description: Verifies that the absolute paths for nginx.conf and app.log start with leading slashes from Root.
tests.failure_message: Absolute path resolution failed for system files. Remember that absolute paths always start at the Root forward slash (/), e.g., /etc/nginx.conf.

tests.name: Project Secrets & Architecture Notes Absolute Paths
tests.description: Verifies absolute paths for .env and architecture-notes.md inside the user home tree.
tests.failure_message: User file absolute paths are incorrect. Check the full path starting from /home/alex.

tests.name: Local Directory Traversal & Child Subfolders
tests.description: Verifies relative paths from cloud-app to package.json (same folder) and index.js (inside src/).
tests.failure_message: Local relative path failed. When a file is in the same folder, reference it directly ('package.json' or './package.json'). When in a subfolder, use 'src/index.js'.

tests.name: Hidden Dotfile Flag & Secret Protection
tests.description: Verifies that .env is flagged as is_hidden: true and cannot be read by group or others.
tests.failure_message: Security vulnerability detected! The production .env file begins with a period (dotfile, is_hidden: true) and must NEVER be readable by group or others.
